text_en: And you, mortal, prophesy to the mountains of Israel, and say: O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord .
text_cn: “人子，你向以色列群山讲预言说：以色列群山，听上主的话吧！

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : Because the enemy said of you, “Aha! ” and, “The ancient heights have become our possession, ”
text_cn: 吾主上主这样说：因为敌人曾论你们说：‘哈！永远荒凉了，那地已成了我们的产业。’

text_en: therefore prophesy, and say: Thus says the Lord God : Because they made you desolate indeed, and crushed you from all sides, so that you became the possession of the rest of the nations, and you became an object of gossip and slander among the people;
text_cn: 为此你要预言说：吾主上主这样说：因人使你们荒凉了，从各方面侵蚀你们，使你们成为残余民族的产业，并使你们成为人们的口头禅和话柄：

text_en: therefore, O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord God : Thus says the Lord God to the mountains and the hills, the watercourses and the valleys, the desolate wastes and the deserted towns, which have become a source of plunder and an object of derision to the rest of the nations all around;
text_cn: 为此，以色列群山！你们听吾主上主的话罢！吾主上主这样对高山、丘陵、溪涧、山谷、荒凉的废墟，以及那些曾为四周残余民族的掠物和笑柄而被遗弃的城邑说：

text_en: therefore thus says the Lord God : I am speaking in my hot jealousy against the rest of the nations, and against all Edom, who, with wholehearted joy and utter contempt, took my land as their possession, because of its pasture, to plunder it.
text_cn: 吾主上主这样说：我必在我妒火中发言攻斥各残余的民族和整个厄东，她们心里怀着幸灾乐祸，和轻视的心情，将我的地方据为自己的产业，劫掠它当作战利品。

text_en: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and say to the mountains and hills, to the watercourses and valleys, Thus says the Lord God : I am speaking in my jealous wrath, because you have suffered the insults of the nations;
text_cn: 为此，你向以色列地域讲预言，对高山、丘陵、溪涧和山谷说：吾主上主这样说：因为你们遭受了异民的凌辱，看，我必在妒火和愤怒中发言。

text_en: therefore thus says the Lord God : I swear that the nations that are all around you shall themselves suffer insults.
text_cn: 为此，吾主上主这样说：我举手起誓：你们四周的异民必要遭受他们当受的凌辱。

text_en: But you, O mountains of Israel, shall shoot out your branches, and yield your fruit to my people Israel; for they shall soon come home.
text_cn: 以色列群山，你们要给我的百姓以色列生出枝叶，结出果实，因为他们快来到了。

text_en: See now, I am for you; I will turn to you, and you shall be tilled and sown;
text_cn: 看，我偕同你们，眷顾你们，使你们得以耕种，得以播种，

text_en: and I will multiply your population, the whole house of Israel, all of it; the towns shall be inhabited and the waste places rebuilt;
text_cn: 在你们那里增加全以色列家族的人数，使城邑再有居民，废墟得以重建。

text_en: and I will multiply human beings and animals upon you. They shall increase and be fruitful; and I will cause you to be inhabited as in your former times, and will do more good to you than ever before. Then you shall know that I am the Lord .
text_cn: 我要在你们那里，使人和牲畜的数目增多，他们要增加繁殖；我要使你们再有居民，如同昔日一样，优待你们胜过先前，如此，你们便承认我是上主。

text_en: I will lead people upon you—my people Israel—and they shall possess you, and you shall be their inheritance. No longer shall you bereave them of children.
text_cn: 我要引领人，即我的百姓以色列到你们上面，他们要占领你，你要成为他们的产业，再不使他们丧失子女。

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : Because they say to you, “You devour people, and you bereave your nation of children, ”
text_cn: 吾主上主这样说：因为人向你说：你吞噬了人，并使你的百姓丧失子女；

text_en: therefore you shall no longer devour people and no longer bereave your nation of children, says the Lord God ;
text_cn: 从此你不再吞噬人，也不再使你的百姓丧失子女 —— 吾主上主的断语 ——

text_en: and no longer will I let you hear the insults of the nations, no longer shall you bear the disgrace of the peoples; and no longer shall you cause your nation to stumble, says the Lord God .
text_cn: 我不再让在你那里听到异民的凌辱，你也不再受异民咒骂，也不再使你的百姓丧失子女 —— 吾主上主的断语。”

text_en: The word of the Lord came to me:
text_cn: 上主的话传给我说：

text_en: Mortal, when the house of Israel lived on their own soil, they defiled it with their ways and their deeds; their conduct in my sight was like the uncleanness of a woman in her menstrual period.
text_cn: “人子，以色列家族住在自己的地域时，以自己的品行和作为玷污了此地，他们的品行在我面前好似经期的污秽。

text_en: So I poured out my wrath upon them for the blood that they had shed upon the land, and for the idols with which they had defiled it.
text_cn: 因他们在此地所流的血，又因他们的偶像玷污了此地，我遂在他们身上发泄我的愤怒，

text_en: I scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed through the countries; in accordance with their conduct and their deeds I judged them.
text_cn: 将他们分散在异民中，散布在各国，照他们的品行和作为惩罚了他们。

text_en: But when they came to the nations, wherever they came, they profaned my holy name, in that it was said of them, “These are the people of the Lord , and yet they had to go out of his land. ”
text_cn: 他们到了应去的异民那里，还亵渎了我的圣名，因为人们论及他们说：‘这些人原是雅威的百姓，但他们却应当离开他的地域！’

text_en: But I had concern for my holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations to which they came.
text_cn: 我遂怜惜我的圣名，即以色列家族在他们所到的异民中所亵渎的圣名。

text_en: Therefore say to the house of Israel, Thus says the Lord God : It is not for your sake, O house of Israel, that I am about to act, but for the sake of my holy name, which you have profaned among the nations to which you came.
text_cn: 为此，你要告诉以色列家族，吾主上主这样说：以色列家族，我作这事并不是为了你们，而是为了我的圣名，即你们在所到的异民中所亵渎的圣名。

text_en: I will sanctify my great name, which has been profaned among the nations, and which you have profaned among them; and the nations shall know that I am the Lord , says the Lord God , when through you I display my holiness before their eyes.
text_cn: 我要使我的大名显圣，即在异民中被亵渎，即你们在他们中所亵渎的圣名；当我在你们身上，在他们眼前显为圣的时候，异民就要承认我是上主 —— 吾主上主的断语。

text_en: I will take you from the nations, and gather you from all the countries, and bring you into your own land.
text_cn: 我要把你们从异民中领出，从各地聚集你们，领你们回到你们的地域。

text_en: I will sprinkle clean water upon you, and you shall be clean from all your uncleannesses, and from all your idols I will cleanse you.
text_cn: 那时，我要在你们身上洒清水，洁净你们，净化你们脱离各种不洁和各种偶像。

text_en: A new heart I will give you, and a new spirit I will put within you; and I will remove from your body the heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh.
text_cn: 我还要赐给你们一颗新心，在你们五内放上一种新的精神，从你们的肉身内取去铁石的心，给你们换上一颗血肉的心。

text_en: I will put my spirit within you, and make you follow my statutes and be careful to observe my ordinances.
text_cn: 我要将我的神赐于你们五内，使你们遵行我的规律，恪守我的诫命，且一一实行。

text_en: Then you shall live in the land that I gave to your ancestors; and you shall be my people, and I will be your God.
text_cn: 如此，你们要居住在我赐给你们祖先的地方；你们要作我的百姓，我作你们的天主。

text_en: I will save you from all your uncleannesses, and I will summon the grain and make it abundant and lay no famine upon you.
text_cn: 我要救你们脱离各种不洁，命五谷丰登，不再让你们遭受饥荒。

text_en: I will make the fruit of the tree and the produce of the field abundant, so that you may never again suffer the disgrace of famine among the nations.
text_cn: 我要使树上的果实，田间的出产丰收，免得你们因饥荒受异民凌辱。

text_en: Then you shall remember your evil ways, and your dealings that were not good; and you shall loathe yourselves for your iniquities and your abominable deeds.
text_cn: 那时你们记起了你们的恶行和那些不好的行为，连你们自己对你们的罪过和丑恶之事，也感觉讨厌。

text_en: It is not for your sake that I will act, says the Lord God ; let that be known to you. Be ashamed and dismayed for your ways, O house of Israel.
text_cn: 你们应清楚知道：我作这事并不是为了你们 —— 吾主上主的断语 —— 以色列家族！对你们的品行害羞惭愧吧！

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : On the day that I cleanse you from all your iniquities, I will cause the towns to be inhabited, and the waste places shall be rebuilt.
text_cn: 吾主上主这样说：在我洁化你们脱离各种罪过的那天，使城邑有人居住，废墟得以重建，

text_en: The land that was desolate shall be tilled, instead of being the desolation that it was in the sight of all who passed by.
text_cn: 在过客眼中曾为荒芜的地方，再得以耕种之时，

text_en: And they will say, “This land that was desolate has become like the garden of Eden; and the waste and desolate and ruined towns are now inhabited and fortified. ”
text_cn: 人们要说：那曾荒废的地方，如今成了‘伊甸’乐园；荒芜废弃和破坏的城邑，如今成了设防安居之地。

text_en: Then the nations that are left all around you shall know that I, the Lord , have rebuilt the ruined places, and replanted that which was desolate; I, the Lord , have spoken, and I will do it.
text_cn: 如此，你们四周的残余民族便承认，是我上主重建了破坏的城，种植了荒废的地。我上主言出必行。

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : I will also let the house of Israel ask me to do this for them: to increase their population like a flock.
text_cn: 吾主上主这样说：我还要让以色列家族求我实行这事：叫他们的人数繁殖，多如羊群；

text_en: Like the flock for sacrifices, like the flock at Jerusalem during her appointed festivals, so shall the ruined towns be filled with flocks of people. Then they shall know that I am the Lord .
text_cn: 就如被奉献的羊群，就如在庆节日耶路撒冷的羊群有多少，荒芜的城邑也要充满那么多的人群：如此，他们便承认我是上主。”
